reviewer_scope: Read-only source review of the new shard, lock-generation and dispatch logic; no archived program execution, original ZIP download, native test execution or product qualification.
inspected: bazel_list accepts a nonempty unique test inventory, rejects benchmarks, and permits an empty ignored inventory only explicitly.

inspect_shards requires the exact retained report names for one/four/one original shards, a unique success summary per shard, exact case/counter agreement, no duplicate names within/across shards, correct FNV assignment, exact original ignored cases, inventory-conserving per-shard filters and complete disjoint coverage.

inspect_bazel binds exact inventory/ignored-inventory commands with sharding disabled only for bazel run, retains the original test and Clippy commands and requires the original three targets to have executed.

inspect_generation requires the exact original eight successful commands in sequence, no source changes awaiting adoption, generated/committed lock bytes equal to exact Git bytes and metadata package counts.

The independently fetched baseline Cargo blob is Git-hash verified; package keys, versions, sources, checksums and unrelated fields remain exact, with only the configured workspace dependency additions accepted.
main selects generation/native/Bazel inspection explicitly for passed evidence and preserves original failed evidence as negative-evidence rather than promoting it.
conclusion: No confirmed new blocker found within this static review scope.
boundaries: Bazel XML checks wrapper success and consistency; complete Rust case identities are established by retained test logs and compiled inventories, not by requiring XML testcase names to equal Rust case names.
Original report freshness and full source binding additionally rely on the existing collection and verify_sources mechanisms; this review did not re-download or replay those artifacts.
No synthetic control, native test, lock generation, original artifact readback or whole-repository CI was run by this review.
This review does not change any product head, source policy, original ignore set or acceptance budget.
